div.div: Nine pillars. Geometry is IMDF/IFC-aligned and keeps stable feature keys across floor-plan revisions (RevisionMapping), so assignments and bookings survive a re-import. Allocation is a versioned event between Bookable and Bookings; Rules govern allocation, booking and check-in. References to Person, Group and Role are written in the cards (→) rather than drawn. Each relation is coloured by the pillar it starts from. Integration is what crosses the boundary (sync, devices, exports, API access); Events & history is what happened and who is told. Grey dashed = spaceweave-owned, not offered by any surveyed vendor.

switch.text: Nine pillars. Geometry is IMDF/IFC-aligned and keeps stable feature keys across floor-plan revisions (RevisionMapping), so assignments and bookings survive a re-import. Allocation is a versioned event between Bookable and Bookings; Rules govern allocation, booking and check-in. References to Person, Group and Role are written in the cards (→) rather than drawn. Each relation is coloured by the pillar it starts from. Integration is what crosses the boundary (sync, devices, exports, API access); Events & history is what happened and who is told. Grey dashed = spaceweave-owned, not offered by any surveyed vendor.
